name: antislop
summary: Rules that stop AI coding agents from producing generic AI-slop UI, copy and code comments — a filter, not a style guide.
description: A rule set for AI coding agents against generic AI-generated UI and copy: 38 mandatory rules in three tiers (Hard Gate, Purpose-Gate, Quality Locks), a Liveliness Toolkit with ENERGY/RHYTHM/MOTION dials and a Design Read, and a mandatory PASS/FAIL Delivery Gate report. It ships as six Agent Skills folders (core, ui, copywriting, human, layoutmobile, code) that install into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Antigravity, OpenCode, Gemini CLI and Hermes, or as a single markdown file you paste anywhere. It prescribes no colors, fonts or layouts — direction comes from your own DESIGN.md.
